Beyond Our Flagship Events

Different Formats for Different Objectives.

Banking CEE partnerships extend beyond our flagship events, creating opportunities for more targeted engagement with the regional banking community.

01 — FLAGSHIP EVENTS

Banking CEE Expo & Digital Banking CEE Summit

  • 100–300 senior decision-makers
  • Thought leadership and speaking opportunities
  • Exhibition and brand visibility
  • 1:1 meetings and networking
  • Regional engagement across the Banking CEE community

Great for: organisations looking for broader visibility, thought leadership and access to banking decision-makers across CEE.

02 — TAILORED EVENTS

Your Audience. Your Topic. Your Event.

  • 20–30 pre-qualified industry attendees

  • Direct engagement in a focused environment

Great for: organisations looking for high-touch engagement with selected decision-makers around a specific topic, market or business objective.
